metaDescription: Order custom unisex personal protection equipment for your team. Bulk pricing on safety glasses, bandanas, and hi-vis shirts at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Unisex personal protection equipment offers a streamlined solution for teams that need gear fitting all body types without separate men's and women's lines. From adjustable safety glasses and tubular bandanas to Class 2 hi-vis UPF shirts, unisex PPE simplifies ordering and inventory while keeping everyone protected. These versatile items work across industries—construction, manufacturing, or outdoor events—and can be decorated with your logo for a professional, unified look.
